_: Known gaps between web/src/api/types.ts and doc/core/api-shapes.json. Checked by tests/unit/api-types-contract.test.mjs (EZ-1772).
_waivers: Every waiver needs a fingerprint (rule|interface|property), a note, and an issue id — a waiver without them is rejected at load, because 'we decided this is fine' and 'nobody looked' must not be the same state. A waiver that stops firing FAILS the test: delete it when the fix lands, rather than leaving a permission behind that silently re-permits the problem if it returns.
_unannotated: Interfaces in web/src/api that carry no @endpoint or @requestBody line, so nothing compares them to the wire. This list can only shrink: a new unannotated interface fails, and so does an entry that is now annotated, renamed or deleted.
_limitation: Only `interface` declarations are seen. Request bodies declared inline in a mutationFn signature are neither checked nor listed below — invisible rather than merely uncovered. ~40 mutating endpoints, one @requestBody annotation. EZ-1779.
